prompts.name: Target research and creation
prompts.description: Finds, verifies and adds new targets for the chosen section and scope, and schedules their next steps. It changes the tracker directly.
prompts.whenToUse: You want new targets in the tracker. Pick a preset to set the scope and the examples.

prompts.name: Outreach and strategy plan
prompts.description: Writes a campaign plan for the chosen section and scope from the targets already in the tracker. It reads the tracker and changes nothing.
prompts.whenToUse: The scope already has targets and you want an order, dates and materials before acting on them. Any preset fills its variables unchanged.
